text.p: These are the leading stories in Zambia's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Courts in the northern mining town of Kitwe were paralysed on Monday as a strike by judicial officers entered its second day.
- Japan released 7.3 billion kwacha for a water project in Lusaka.
- A Lusaka court denied bail to 67 suspects charged with rioting because it would be difficult to trace them if they were released.
- Labour minister Peter Machungwa cautioned unions against illegal strikes, saying such action could lead to their members being dismissed.

- The opposition Zambia Democratic Congress proposed that an alliance of opposition parties form a parallel government to counter President Frederick Chiluba's government, which has refused to call for early elections.
